messages:
kevin: Heads-up — BetaHealth reported their monthly credits hit zero at 2026-04-01 23:59 CET during a batch import. UI flipped to zero and their jobs started getting 429s. They captured the API response headers and said the refill time in the header was 2026-04-02T00:00:00Z but 429s persisted for ~90s after that.

kevin: Pasted headers they captured:

```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
X-RateLimit-Limit: 5000000
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
X-Credits-Refill-Time: 2026-04-02T00:00:00Z
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2026 00:00:02 GMT
X-Request-Id: req-0a1b2c3d
```

tia: Can you confirm tenant id and timezone, and whether they had websocket longstreams or many short requests?

kevin: tenant: b-health-77, timezone = Europe/Paris. They were running 3 concurrent websocket ingest streams with aggressive retry enabled. SDK v1.3.4.

ryan: I checked the refill cron and ledger writes: refill for the tenant was written at 2026-04-02T00:00:00Z (ledger write present). Enforcement shard s-3 logged a cache refresh at 2026-04-02T00:00:45Z. Enforcement used stale remaining==0 until that refresh and returned 429s.

ops_oncall: We also saw a reconciliation backlog on q-ledger-reconcile between 2026-04-01T23:59:50Z and 2026-04-02T00:01:20Z due to the ingestion spike. Cache TTL is 60s; combined with enqueue lag that explains ~80s of sticky 429s after the refill.

kevin: Customer says they couldn't continue the import for roughly 2 minutes. They want a clear explanation and mitigation steps.

ryan: Suggested mitigations: (1) engineering task to emit a refill-ack event propagated to enforcement shards immediately at refill, (2) consider reducing enforcement cache TTL around monthly boundaries, (3) recommend customers implement exponential backoff and check X-Credits-Refill-Time to retry after the boundary.

tia: Repro steps for support to validate: 1) In staging, create tenant with Europe/Paris timezone and a small monthly bucket (e.g., 10M). 2) Launch 3 websocket ingest sessions to exhaust the bucket quickly. 3) Capture enforcement node response headers and UI balance every 10s across the boundary. 4) Capture reconcile queue length and shard cache invalidation timing.

support_bot: Ticket INC-5910 created and assigned to ryan and ops_oncall. Priority: P2. Please attach request ids and the customer's captured headers.

kevin: I'll request request ids, SDK logs, and the customer's retry trace.

tia: For postmortem, add a metric: time(refill-write) -> time(enforcement-ack) per tenant and alert if >30s. Also add a docs section explaining edge-case behavior around monthly boundary flushes.

ryan: Operational note: include ledger-write-timestamp in the X-Credits-Refill-Time header value so clients can disambiguate when refill was applied vs when enforcement saw it.

ops_oncall: Posting initial logs to INC-5910; will follow up with a timeline and quick config suggestions.

kevin: Thanks — I will keep BetaHealth updated.
